_note: The presenters. michael and emma are invented people: each face was generated from the text prompt below with Z-Image-Turbo (Apache-2.0), not from a photo of anyone, and a resemblance to a real person is unintended. Their voices are the michael and emma prompts of starling's podcast-server (Kokoro-82M samples, Apache-2.0). goran, goran-classic, goran-warm, goran-tutor, goran-home-polo and goran-library-polo are Goran Jovanov, the maintainer, with his consent to publish them (2026-10-21; the white-polo pair 2026-10-25); his voice prompts are not in this repository. A real person's entry needs "real_person": true and their recorded consent, and, unless they agreed to publish their face, "portrait": "private:<file>" so it stays out of the repository (docs/real-person.md). Every video that shows a presenter carries the AI label from the first frame.

michael.label: Michael
michael.portrait_model: Z-Image-Turbo bf16 (Comfy-Org/z_image_turbo), 1024x1024, 9 steps, cfg 1, res_multistep/simple, shift 3
michael.portrait_prompt: Photograph of a friendly American man in his late thirties, the host of a tech video podcast, sitting in a calm studio and looking straight into the camera with a relaxed, slight closed-mouth smile. Short brown hair, light stubble, warm brown eyes, a plain charcoal t-shirt. Head and shoulders, centred, eye level, room above his head. Behind him a dark teal wall with softly blurred bookshelves and a warm desk lamp. Soft key light from the front left, a subtle rim light, natural skin texture with visible pores, shot on a 50mm lens at f/2.8, sharp focus on the eyes, realistic colour, no text, no logo.
michael.talk_prompt: A man is talking to the camera on a video podcast. He speaks clearly and with energy, with natural head movements, raised eyebrows on his key words, blinks and small nods, relaxed shoulders. Static camera, soft studio lighting, the background stays still.

emma.label: Emma
emma.portrait_model: Z-Image-Turbo bf16 (Comfy-Org/z_image_turbo), 1024x1024, 9 steps, cfg 1, res_multistep/simple, shift 3
emma.portrait_prompt: Photograph of a friendly British woman in her early thirties, the co-host of a tech video podcast, sitting in a calm studio and looking straight into the camera with a relaxed, slight closed-mouth smile. Shoulder-length wavy auburn hair, green eyes, light freckles, a soft cream knit sweater. Head and shoulders, centred, eye level, room above her head. Behind her a dark teal wall with softly blurred bookshelves and a warm desk lamp. Soft key light from the front right, a subtle rim light, natural skin texture with visible pores, shot on a 50mm lens at f/2.8, sharp focus on the eyes, realistic colour, no text, no logo.
emma.talk_prompt: A woman is talking to the camera on a video podcast. She speaks clearly and with warmth and humour, with natural head movements, expressive eyebrows, blinks and small nods, relaxed shoulders. Static camera, soft studio lighting, the background stays still.

His hands do the talking like a politician's: firm gestures at chest height, an open palm held out, a thumb pressed on a loosely closed fist for emphasis, a hand chopping down on each key point, both hands opening wide. The camera and the room behind him stay still.
